title: Painting a Frog and Wondering about Umwelt
content: Inthis new video,I paint a green frog from life. I'll need him to hold still over an hour. Will he do it?I consider the question of the frog’sUmweltor its particular viewpoint of its environment, and I pose the philosophical question of whether we can ever understand the subjective experience or the cognitive ability of any animal, given that it lives in a very different perceptual environment.---"I Paint a Frog and Wonder What He Sees" on YouTubeBook:"Outermost House" by Henry Beston
